subject: Game Theory
title: Disruption as a Game
description: A quick win: understand Disruption as a Game.

hook.text: Netflix started mailing DVDs. Blockbuster laughed. Then Netflix pivoted to streaming and Blockbuster died.

buildup.text: Disruptors enter with inferior products targeting overlooked segments. Incumbents dismiss them—rationally.

discovery.text: The disruptor improves fast. By the time the incumbent reacts, the game has already shifted.

twist.text: Incumbents can't easily respond: their existing customers, cost structure, and culture resist change.

climax.text: Clayton Christensen's 'Innovator's Dilemma' showed that doing everything right can still mean losing.

punchline.text: The rational response is the fatal one.

quiz.question: Why do incumbents often fail to respond to disruptors?
